title: Reward now, activity later
hook: Two stated cases: explore a specified activity path rather than a universal reward effect.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How a specified activity path rather than a universal reward effect affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Remaining, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare a specified activity path rather than a universal reward effect in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
